# Owl20 Documentation Overview

> Bridge Beyond20 dice roll data to Owlbear Rodeo. This site provides installation guides for players and DMs, troubleshooting, technical architecture documentation, and FAQ.

This `llms.txt` helps AI systems link to the most useful parts of Owl20's user documentation hosted at `https://owl20.uberdragon.org/`.

## Setup Guides
- Player Setup — https://owl20.uberdragon.org/player-setup.html
  - Install Beyond20 and Owl20 browser extensions, configure Beyond20 custom domains, verify dice roll delivery to Owlbear Rodeo.
- DM Setup — https://owl20.uberdragon.org/dm-setup.html
  - Install the Owl20 OBR extension via manifest URL, enable per room, verify integration.
- Quick Start Overview — https://owl20.uberdragon.org/
  - Overview of the full system with links to player and DM guides.

## Troubleshooting
- Troubleshooting Guide — https://owl20.uberdragon.org/troubleshooting.html
  - Diagnosis checklist, fix for dice rolls not appearing, extension not loading, browser-specific notes for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Opera.

## Technical Details
- How It Works — https://owl20.uberdragon.org/how-it-works.html
  - Architecture deep dive: CustomEvent listeners for Beyond20_Roll events, postMessage API for cross-origin iframe communication, MutationObserver for automatic iframe detection, Manifest V3 content script design.

## FAQ
- FAQ — https://owl20.uberdragon.org/faq.html
  - 33 questions covering installation, Beyond20 configuration, browser support, privacy, permissions, and common issues.

## About
- About Owl20 — https://owl20.uberdragon.org/about.html
  - Creator bios for DM UberDragon (25+ years software engineering) and DM Sparks (Owlbear Rodeo extension API), Starry Shores D&D Community background.
